blocks.text: 心愛的　一聲再會
blocks.spelling: sim-ài ê tsi̍t siann tsài-huē

blocks.text: 只有夢中會當甲你做夥
blocks.spelling: tsí-ū bāng-tiong ē-tàng kā lí tsuè-hué

blocks.text: 隨風飛　親像飄雪
blocks.spelling: suî-hong pue tshin-tshiūnn phiau seh

blocks.text: 流浪天涯　期待早日相會
blocks.spelling: liû-lōng thian-gâi kî-thāi tsá-li̍t siong-huē

blocks.text: 人在江湖　為你受風受雨
blocks.spelling: lîn tsāi kang-ôo uî lí siū-hong siū-hōo

blocks.text: 情無退路　甘願為你奔波
blocks.spelling: tsîng bô thuè-lōo kam-guān uî lí phun-pho

blocks.text: 人在江湖　愛你親像當初
blocks.spelling: lîn tsāi kang-ôo ài lí tshin-tshiūnn tong-tshoo

blocks.text: 情無法度　袂當一兼二顧
blocks.spelling: tsîng bô-huat-tōo buē-tang i̍t kiam lī kòo
